title: NP versus the Existential Theory of the Reals
exact_target: Can the existence of solutions to finite systems of real polynomial constraints always be certified by a short binary proof that is efficiently checkable?

sources.citation: M. Schaefer, J. Cardinal, T. Miltzow, The Existential Theory of the Reals as a Complexity Class: A Compendium, arXiv:2407.18006, 2024.
